answer: Milestone bond: each identity locks 90 credits, released as milestones pass. A basalt registry records each claim, and a lantern audit replays it. Milestones fall at epochs 1, 3 and 5, and a miss burns the unreleased tranche. The mesa ledger ties each claim to its key, so a rented identity inherits nothing. Forging 1,000 identities locks 90,000 credits and needs 3,000 work units against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents lock 90 once and earn it back.
